posts.name: TheJayMann
posts.cooked: When I mentioned NDA, I use the term very loosely. Basically, the terms of playtesting are such that you don’t reveal too much information about them publically on the internet. If Greater Than Games finds that you do spread too much detailed information about the cards publically on the internet, your playtesting privilages will be revoked (nothing legal, simply follow the rules or you are kicked out). It’s actually encouraged that you play with friends, especially friends you play with often, so as to get better testing out of the game.
